versions.changelog:
- Initial release of chat-record-generator (聊天记录生成) skill.
- Generate simulated WeChat group chat Excel files (.xlsx) with three sheets: group_info, active_members, and message_stream.
- Supports multi-agent (multi-role) parallel generation of chat content.
- Fully compatible with Pai platform’s group chat training data format.
- Covers multiple use cases, including AI assistant training data, FAQ system testing, workflow demos, and themed group chat samples.
- Detailed documentation on group definition, workflow, message assignment, time formatting, and Excel/xlsx requirements included.
